entities.name: Jean-René Lisnard
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-René Lisnard is a French-Monegasque retired professional tennis player who formerly represented France. He was a member of the Monaco Davis Cup team from 2007. He is the first Monegasque tennis player to have won a match in the main draw of a Grand Slam tournament.
